title: MORTA
description: A sculptural sterling-silver jewellery house with cinematic photography and interactive ring studies.

sections.title: The Oath / hero
sections.summary: An elegant header with the mark, Collection, House, Craft and Commissions anchors and a prominent commission link. Use `morta-hero` as a cinematic image with a dark text-safe region. Headline: “Wear what remains.” Supporting copy: “Sculptural silver for the stories we carry.” Primary CTA: “Discover the collection.” Add a restrained object label and a scroll cue.

sections.title: The House
sections.summary: Introduce MORTA: “Objects of devotion, made to endure.” Describe sculptural silver, attentive finishing and pieces intended to gather their own history. Pair an oversized editorial statement with the first separated ring contours and fine graphic linework.

sections.title: The Collection
sections.summary: Present the three supplied product images as distinct, large editorial product cards, numbered 01–03: Reliquary / signet ring; Thorn / pendant; Vigil / drop earrings. Show product names and concise descriptive copy. Cards can reveal more detail on interaction, but names and essential information must remain visible on touch and keyboard. If purchase links have no destination, use in-page exploration rather than dead links.

sections.title: The Craft
sections.summary: Pair `morta-craft` with copy about shaping, casting and finishing silver. This section hosts the signature assembly: a pinned or otherwise scroll-linked graphic progressively gathers fragments into a complete ring. The finished image frames a statement such as “Formed slowly. Worn for years.” The graphic is an original SVG/CSS drawing, not a replacement for the real product photography.
sections.customCodeReason: Contains interactive 3D/WebGL, procedural canvas, or pinned scroll-scrubbed stage requiring an HtmlEmbed + page footer script.

sections.title: Bespoke commissions
sections.summary: Pair `morta-bespoke` with an invitation to create a personal piece. Provide a usable enquiry form with name, email and a short description. Include labels, helpful validation, keyboard access and a clear success state. If no backend is specified, implement a transparent demonstration-only success state and do not claim that an enquiry was sent.

sections.title: Footer
sections.summary: Reprise the mark and phrase “Made to outlast the moment.” Include working in-page navigation, a short brand line and contact/enquiry access. Avoid fabricated addresses, social profiles or contact information.

customCodeBlocks.title: MORTA Scoped Styles
customCodeBlocks.description: Authored custom CSS variables, pseudo-elements, and keyframe rules that supplement native Webflow styles.

customCodeBlocks.title: MORTA Interactive Runtime Bridge
customCodeBlocks.description: Loads three in page footer custom code with prefers-reduced-motion guard.
